entities.name: Hermann Pokorny
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hermann Pokorny was a World War I Austro-Hungarian Army cryptologist whose work with Russian ciphers contributed substantially to Central Powers victories over Russia. He was a member of the Hungarian Order of Vitéz.
